user.title: Set up Family Tasks
user.description: Creates local family tasks, a calendar, and a to-do list.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Create a one-off or recurring family task.

start.name: Start or due date
start.description: Required for one-off tasks. A date without time, interpreted in the Home Assistant time zone.

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Edit a task. Switching between one-off and recurring is not supported.

start.name: Due date
start.description: Reschedule open one-off tasks only. Completed and archived dates are protected.
